text: But by what is it (the Samsara) again brought to an end? When there is knowledge of the twenty-five Tattvas: this is Prakriti, this is Buddhi, this is Ahamkara, these are the five Tanmatras, these are the eleven Indriyas, these are the five Mahabhutas, and the Purusha is different from all of these. By such knowledge, the cessation of the marks (of Samsara) occurs, and from that, liberation follows.
